component.name: ClamAV-GUI
component.summary: Qt front-end for the ClamAV antivirus engine

description.p: ClamAV-GUI wraps the ClamAV antivirus engine in a Qt interface: on-demand and scheduled scans, signature updates through freshclam, and clamd configuration, without touching the command line.

Scans can be launched from the window or by dropping files onto the drop zone; results, quarantine handling and scan logs are presented per profile. The UI ships German natively and carries community translations that the author asks native speakers to review.
